probes.cmd: git cat-file -p HEAD 2>&1 | head -3; echo exit=$?
git verify-pack -v .git/objects/pack/*.idx 2>&1 | awk '/^[0-9a-f]{40}/ {print $1, $2}' | sort; echo exit=$?
for p in .git/objects/pack/*.pack; do git index-pack --verify "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "$(basename $p .pack | sed 's/[0-9a-f]\{40\}/HASH/') verify=$?"; done
git fsck 2>&1 | sed 's/[0-9a-f]\{40\}/OID/g' | sort; echo exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
git show-ref >../sr.out 2>../sr.err; rc=$?; sort ../sr.out; test -s ../sr.err && echo 'error reported' || echo 'no error'; test $rc -eq 0 && echo 'exit ok' || echo 'exit nonzero'
git clone -q . ../reclone 2>&1; echo clone=$?; git -C ../reclone log --oneline 2>&1 | head -3
git fsck >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'fsck clean' || echo 'fsck reports a problem'
bad=0; for p in .git/objects/pack/*.pack; do git index-pack --verify "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || bad=$((bad+1)); done; test $bad -eq 0 && echo 'every pack verifies' || echo 'a pack fails verification'
